# open_hours v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Time calculations using business hours

## Modules

- [OpenHours](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.md): Documentation for OpenHours.

- [OpenHours.Common](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.Common.md)
- [OpenHours.Duration](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.Duration.md): This module contains functions to calculate business time duration.

- [OpenHours.Interval](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.Interval.md): This module contains functions for working with intervals of time.

- [OpenHours.Offset](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.Offset.md): This module provides business time arithmetic operations.
- [OpenHours.Schedule](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.Schedule.md): This module contains functions to work with schedules.
- [OpenHours.TimeSlot](https://open-hours.hexdocs.pm/OpenHours.TimeSlot.md): This module contains all functions to work with time slots.
